scope: Closed/front phone only. The UIKit recognizer exists only in the front workspace and detaches on removal. Shared swipe-protection annotations emit no anchors outside that scope and change no frames, actions or styles. Existing wide browser, dock, fader and geometry files are unchanged.
review: One-finger horizontal direction/threshold gate; touch-start protected regions; native musical surfaces and text/control exclusion; no transport/fader start; existing drag handles and loader protected; hidden drawer/retired deck annotations disabled; contact identity prevents a stale swipe from replacing a later selection. Catalogue loading and current request readiness take precedence over empty text.
acceptance: Erik checks selector and blank-area swipes, vertical scrolling, pane resizing, loader/transport/fader isolation, loading text and clean audio. Duo only, no iPad operation.
